# Plugin host API

Public core APIs supported for external plugins. Use these `Syrus::Host`
facades instead of their underlying core constants. Unlisted facades and
unlisted members are internal.

## Public APIs

### `Syrus::Host::AdminController`

Since: `0.1.16`

Bases admin-token plugin API controllers; core filters and implementation details are not promised. Only the listed members are supported.

Supported members:

- `params`
- `render`
